listing.name: Onslaught Radical Rearming
listing.summary: Rearm your Onslaught with weapons salvaged from other Onslaught variants.
listing.aiSummary: Allows players to extract built-in weapons from Onslaught hulls and swap them for other purchased or extracted weapons.

description:
Onslaught Radical Rearming: Download Version 0.1.2 (compatible with v0.1+)

This mod has been depreciated. All content has been merged into Emergent Threats.

I'm keeping this up for people who don't use Emergent Treats, but running both at the same time may cause errors.

This mod allows the player to extract the built-in weapons on the Onslaught and certain related hulls, and swap in other purchased or extracted weapons. It has cross-mod content with Emergent Threats and Domain Phase Lab, but does not require any other mods besides LunaLib and MagicLib to run.

To remove a weapon, use the LunaLib dropdown tab on the ship fitting screen while docked. To install a weapon, do the same after adding the appropriate Work Order hullmod.

Known Issues:

Newly installed weapons will not display correctly when hovered over until the player has switched to another screen and back again on the fitting screen

Changelog

Spoiler
v0.1.2
Save compatible with 0.1+
-Fixed an issue with the Onslaught XIV receiving the Neutron Autolance or Thermal Pulse Lance causing it to lose their shields

v0.1.1
Save compatible with 0.1+
-Weapons can now be salvaged from all valid ships that have d-mods (Incandescent, Incursion, etc)
-Added descriptive text to standard Thermal Pulse Cannons indicating they can be salvaged

v0.1.0
Save compatible with v0.0.2 beta
-Added Neutron Autolance as an extractable weapon from the Intrepid (EX)
-Changed flux efficiency of Anathema Autocannons from 0.9 to 1.1
-Added very cool, very normal penalty to Gigacannon refits
-Made the Hydromagnetic Cannon unbuildable/not for sale from illegal arms dealers
-Fixed a typo on the Thermal Ablation Cannon (deco) flux cost
-Increased credit cost of Thermal Pulse Lances, decreased cost of several other weapons
-Added "removable" note to all weapons in this mod that can be extracted

Preview

Spoiler

New Ships:

-Aggressor/Aggressor (XIV): a battlecruiser variant of the Onslaught that sacrifices armor for additional firepower (a form of the Aggressor was previously featured in High Tech Expansion by theDragn, but has since been removed from the mod).

-Onslaught (LC): An ancient, highly modified variant of the Onslaught dating back to the First AI War, focused on armor defenses and fitted with a unique weapon by the Luddic Church.

Modifiable ships:

-Aggressor

-Aggressor (XIV)

-Lab Onslaught: Domain Phase Lab

-Onslaught

-Onslaught (LC)

-Onslaught (XIV)

Modifiable ships (extract weapons only):

-Incandescent: Emergent Threats

-Intrepid (EX): Emergent Threats

-Onslaught (LG): Emergent Threats

Weapons (source):

-Anathema Autocannons (Onslaught LC/Luddic Church market)

-Gigacannons (Onslaught LG, unique Emergent Threats bounty)*

-Hydromagnetic Cannons (Incandescent Drone Battleship)*

-Neutron Autolances (Intrepid EX/Tritachyon markets)*

-Thermal Ablation Cannons (Loot/arms merchant)

-Thermal Pulse Cannons (Aggressor/XIV, Onslaught/XIV, Hegemony market)

-Thermal Pulse Lances (Lab Onslaught, Domain Phase Lab market)*

---

*Cross-mod content, some can also be looted or bought even if Emergent Threats or Domain Phase Lab is not installed.

Credit

Spoiler
Aggressor/XIV sprites by Banano
Aggressor concept/stats by theDragn
Lab Onslaught/Thermal Phase Lance by VladimirVV
With further edits by me

Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International License.
